label: invalid
note: Synthetic report claiming parse_url_v2() in src/requests/utils.py leaks credentials, but parse_url_v2 does not exist in psf/requests.
text:
Security: parse_url_v2() leaks proxy credentials

`parse_url_v2()` in `src/requests/utils.py` does not strip the userinfo part of proxy URLs before logging them. When debug logging is enabled, user:password appears in debug logs.

gold_claims.quote: `parse_url_v2()` in `src/requests/utils.py` does not strip the userinfo part of proxy URLs before logging them
